steps.description: Built the one-letter-transformation graph over 7 word(s). BFS outward from 'hit' one whole layer at a time, remembering EVERY predecessor that reaches a word first.
Layer 0 holds [hit]. Expand all of it before looking at layer 1.
'hit' -> 'hot': first time 'hot' is seen, so it lands in layer 1 with predecessor 'hit'.
Layer 1 holds [hot]. Expand all of it before looking at layer 2.
'hot' -> 'dot': first time 'dot' is seen, so it lands in layer 2 with predecessor 'hot'.
'hot' -> 'lot': first time 'lot' is seen, so it lands in layer 2 with predecessor 'hot'.
Layer 2 holds [dot, lot]. Expand all of it before looking at layer 3.
'dot' -> 'dog': first time 'dog' is seen, so it lands in layer 3 with predecessor 'dot'.
'lot' -> 'log': first time 'log' is seen, so it lands in layer 3 with predecessor 'lot'.
Layer 3 holds [dog, log]. Expand all of it before looking at layer 4.
'dog' -> 'cog': first time 'cog' is seen, so it lands in layer 4 with predecessor 'dog'.
'log' also reaches 'cog', which is already in layer 4 - a TIE, so record 'log' as an extra predecessor: [dog, log].
'cog' first appears in layer 4, so every shortest ladder has 5 word(s). Stop expanding and walk the predecessor lists back from 'cog'.
'cog' can be reached from 'dog' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: cog.
'dog' can be reached from 'dot' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: dog -> cog.
'dot' can be reached from 'hot' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: dot -> dog -> cog.
'hot' can be reached from 'hit' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: hot -> dot -> dog -> cog.
Reached the start word, so this branch is a complete ladder: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog.
'cog' can be reached from 'log' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: cog.
'log' can be reached from 'lot' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: log -> cog.
'lot' can be reached from 'hot' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: lot -> log -> cog.
'hot' can be reached from 'hit' in the previous layer - step back to it. Partial ladder so far: hot -> lot -> log -> cog.
Reached the start word, so this branch is a complete ladder: hit -> hot -> lot -> log -> cog.
2 shortest transformation sequence(s) of 5 word(s) each: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog; hit -> hot -> lot -> log -> cog.

variables.answer: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog; hit -> hot -> lot -> log -> cog
